g.title: BATT_POS
g.text: TODO: confirm battery location and cable run length. E36 stock location is driver-side footwell -- long cable run. Many builds relocate battery to engine bay or trunk for weight.

g.title: W_BATT_POS_MAIN
g.text: TODO: 4 AWG or 2 AWG depending on cable run length. Red. Ring lug both ends.

g.title: W_CONDENSER_FAN_LOAD
g.text: Inline 20A fuse from BATT+ :: RELAY_CONDENSER_FAN pin 30. 12 AWG.

g.title: MAIN_FUSE
g.text: Inline ANL or MAXI fuse holder

Must be mounted within 18 inches of battery positive terminal. Protects entire power distribution loom from dead short. TODO: size after summing all fused circuit loads with 20% headroom. Blue Sea 5191 (MRBF) or equivalent. Product: https://www.bluesea.com/products/5191/MRBF_Terminal_Fuse_Block_-_30_to_300A

g.title: W_MAIN_TO_FUSE_BLOCK
g.text: TODO: 8-10 AWG from ANL fuse output to fuse block batt+ rail.

g.title: FUSE_BLOCK
g.text: Pins 1-4, 10 powered by IGN-switched +12V (relay coil circuits). Pins 5-7 powered by battery +12V via main fuse (relay load circuits). Pin 9 powered by battery +12V (EWP coil -- must be BATT+ for post-shutdown cooling). Relays switch the load circuits -- the fuses here protect the wires. F9 (EWP coil): 18 AWG to ewp-controller.wv MAIN_RELAY pin 86. BATT+ so MaxxECU power-hold relay can keep pump running after key-off until CLT below 70 deg C. F10 (AC coil): 18 AWG to ac-compressor.wv AC_RELAY pin 86. F4 (Fuel pump SSR ctrl): 18 AWG to fuel-pump-hanger.wv SSR Ctrl(+). TODO: confirm fuse block part. Options: Blue Sea ST Blade (5025), Bussmann 15600, or a pre-made relay+fuse combo block (10-pos).

g.title: W_PUMP_SSR_CTRL_POS
g.text: Fuse F4 :: FUEL_PUMP_SSR Ctrl+. 18 AWG. IGN-switched supply for SSR control circuit.

g.title: W_EWP_RELAY_86
g.text: Fuse F9 (BATT+) :: EWP relay coil pin 86 (in ewp-controller.wv MAIN_RELAY). 18 AWG. BATT+ enables post-shutdown cooling via MaxxECU power-hold.

g.title: W_AC_RELAY_86
g.text: Fuse F10 :: AC relay coil pin 86 (in ac-compressor.wv AC_RELAY). 18 AWG.

g.title: W_PUMP_LOAD_FEED
g.text: FUEL_PUMP_SSR:3:Load+ (from fused BATT+ to pump positive)
Fuse F7 (25A) :: FUEL_PUMP_SSR Load+. 12 AWG. (F90000267 draws 14.1A max -- 8 AWG oversized from old pump spec)

g.title: BATT_NEG
g.text: Negative goes directly to chassis stud. Do NOT run battery negative through the cabin.

g.title: W_BATT_NEG_MAIN
g.text: TODO: same gauge as positive cable. Black. Chassis stud to battery negative.

g.title: CHASSIS_GND
g.text: All negative returns terminate here. E36 engine bay ground stud is on the strut tower or firewall. TODO: confirm exact stud location for this car. Add engine block-to-chassis ground strap (16 AWG min) separately.

g.title: W_FAN_GND
g.text: FAN_MOTOR pin 2 :: chassis GND. 12 AWG. Return current path.

g.title: IGN_12V_SOURCE
g.text: From ignition switch or X20 -- TODO confirm pin

TODO: confirm which ignition switch terminal or X20 pin carries key-on switched +12V for this RHD car. On E36, the ignition switch (pin 15) provides switched +12V. May be accessible at the fuse box or tapped from X20. Wire gauge: 12 AWG to relay coil fuses.

g.title: W_IGN_FEED
g.text: 12 AWG. IGN-switched +12V from ignition switch to fuse block IGN rail.

g.title: RELAY_ECU_MAIN
g.text: ECU logic power relay. Coil: 86 from IGN +12V (F1), 85 to chassis GND. Load: 30 from fused batt+, 87 to MaxxECU 12-pin pin 7 (+12V ECU logic). Keeps ECU unpowered when ignition is off. TODO: MaxxECU Race may handle main relay internally -- verify whether this external relay is required. See maxxecu.com/webhelp section on power supply wiring. Part: Bosch 0332019150 or Tyco V23134 or equivalent. Flyback: 1N4007 across coil at relay socket (cathode to pin 86, anode to pin 85).

g.title: RELAY_COIL_INJ
g.text: Coil pack and injector supply relay. Coil: 86 from IGN +12V (F2), 85 to chassis GND. Load: 30 from fused batt+ (F5 20A), 87 to coil+inj +12V rail. Output feeds MaxxECU 12-pin pin 1 (+12V coil/injector supply). TODO: confirm whether this relay is triggered by IGN directly or by a dedicated ECU relay output. MaxxECU Race has a relay drive output -- check wiring PDF. Wire gauge: 12 AWG on load side. Flyback: 1N4007 across coil at relay socket (cathode to pin 86, anode to pin 85).

g.title: RELAY_FAN
g.text: Radiator fan relay. Coil: 86 from IGN +12V (F3), 85 from MaxxECU GPO 6 (12-pin pin 6). Load: 30 from fused batt+ (F6), 87 to SPAL fan motor positive. Fan motor negative to chassis GND. MaxxECU pulls 85 to GND to energize relay and spin fan. TODO: confirm SPAL fan model and current draw. TODO: Phase 2 upgrade -- SPAL PWM fan wired direct from GPO 6, relay no longer needed. Check SPAL PWM wiring instructions. Flyback: 1N4007 across coil at relay socket (cathode to pin 86, anode to pin 85).

g.title: FUEL_PUMP_SSR
g.text: 3-32V ctrl / 40A load -- replaces mechanical relay for PWM control
Load+ (from fused BATT+ to pump positive)

DC SSR replaces mechanical relay -- enables PWM speed control of Walbro F90000267 via MaxxECU GPO. See harnesses/fuel-pump-hanger.wv for full Radium 20-1170 hanger pinout and hanger connector details. Ctrl+ from fuse F4 (IGN-switched). Ctrl- from MaxxECU GPO 2 (pin 3). Load side: 8 AWG from fused BATT+, output to pump positive stud. Do NOT use with a mechanical relay -- SSR only. Fuse F7 updated to 25A (Walbro F90000267 max draw is ~20A at 13.5V under max load). Mount SSR to metal bracket for heat sinking -- dissipates ~1W/A at load.

g.title: W_PUMP_POS
g.text: FUEL_PUMP_SSR Load- (switched output) :: RADIUM_HANGER_STUB (pump+). 12 AWG. (F90000267 14.1A max)

g.title: EWP_RELAY_COIL_STUB
g.text: See harnesses/ewp-controller.wv MAIN_RELAY -- this is the far end of W_EWP_RELAY_86

Physical wire terminates at MAIN_RELAY pin 86 in ewp-controller.wv. 18 AWG, red. Fuse F9 (5A, BATT+) protects this coil feed. BATT+ source (not IGN) required -- MaxxECU power-hold keeps ECU alive post key-off and commands EWP via GPO until CLT below 70 deg C. IGN-switched would cut pump immediately.

g.title: AC_RELAY_COIL_STUB
g.text: See harnesses/ac-compressor.wv AC_RELAY -- this is the far end of W_AC_RELAY_86
Physical wire terminates at AC_RELAY pin 86 in ac-compressor.wv. 18 AWG, red. Fuse F10 (5A) protects this coil feed.

g.title: ECU_GPO_FAN
g.text: Low-side switch output. Pulls relay pin 85 to GND when fan is commanded. Defined in maxxecu-m52.wv W_FAN cable.

g.title: W_GPO6_FAN_TRIGGER
g.text: MaxxECU 12-pin pin 6 :: RELAY_FAN pin 85. 18 AWG. Low-side switch (pulls to GND).

g.title: ECU_GPO_PUMP
g.text: PWM low-side switch output. Controls Crydom D1D40 SSR Ctrl- for variable-speed fuel pump (Walbro F90000267 via Radium 20-1170 hanger). 65% idle / 100% WOT+boost. Defined in maxxecu-m52.wv W_FUELPUMP cable. See harnesses/fuel-pump-hanger.wv for full SSR and hanger wiring.

g.title: W_GPO2_PUMP_TRIGGER
g.text: MaxxECU 12-pin pin 3 :: FUEL_PUMP_SSR Ctrl-. 18 AWG. Low-side PWM switch.

g.title: ECU_POWER_STUBS
g.text: Both power pins must be supplied. Pin 1: coil and injector supply -- from RELAY_COIL_INJ output. Pin 7: ECU logic supply -- from RELAY_ECU_MAIN output. See maxxecu-m52.wv for full 12-pin connector wiring.

g.title: FAN_MOTOR
g.text: TODO: confirm SPAL fan model and connector. Puller vs pusher depends on radiator position. Common choice: SPAL 30102049 (12-inch puller, 15A). For PWM: SPAL 30102057 + wire GPO 6 direct (no relay needed).

g.title: RADIUM_HANGER_STUB
g.text: SSR Load- (switched output) connects to pump positive stud on Radium 20-1170 hanger. See fuel-pump-hanger.wv for full hanger connector wiring, sender, and return.

g.title: RELAY_CONDENSER_FAN
g.text: Condenser fan relay for AC system. Required -- AC compressor inverter controller will not enable without condenser fan present. Coil pin 86: tapped from AC relay coil wire (after AC switch) so condenser fan turns on simultaneously with compressor. Coil pin 85: chassis GND. Load: dedicated fused BATT+ run (inline 20A fuse, 12 AWG). Output to condenser fan motor +. Fan motor GND to chassis. Flyback: 1N4007 across coil at relay socket (cathode to pin 86, anode to pin 85). If radiator and condenser share one dual-purpose fan: wire this relay output in parallel with RELAY_FAN output -- verify fan can handle combined thermal load before doing so. TODO: confirm condenser fan model (SPAL or equivalent slimline). TODO: confirm whether radiator fan and condenser fan are the same unit.

g.title: W_CONDENSER_FAN_OUT
g.text: RELAY_CONDENSER_FAN:4:87 (NO load out :: condenser fan motor +)

g.title: AC_SWITCH_TAP
g.text: AC enable signal tap -- from ac-compressor.wv AC_SWITCH pin 2
Junction at AC switch output -- see ac-compressor.wv
AC switch output (+12V IGN when AC on)

This wire runs from the AC cabin switch output (after the switch, before relay coil) to RELAY_CONDENSER_FAN coil pin 86. When AC switch is on: energizes both the AC main relay coil (in ac-compressor.wv) AND the condenser fan relay coil here. Ensures condenser fan runs whenever compressor runs. Cross-reference ac-compressor.wv AC_SWITCH and AC_RELAY.

g.title: W_CONDENSER_FAN_RELAY_86
g.text: AC_SWITCH_TAP:1:AC switch output (+12V IGN when AC on)
AC_SWITCH_TAP :: RELAY_CONDENSER_FAN pin 86. 18 AWG. Same signal as AC main relay coil.

g.title: CONDENSER_FAN
g.text: AC condenser fan. Mounts in front of or behind AC condenser. Must run whenever AC compressor is active. TODO: confirm model. SPAL 30102049 (12-inch) or slimline equivalent. GND to chassis ground stud. +12V from RELAY_CONDENSER_FAN pin 87.
